body:
TikTok has become one of the largest platforms for entertainment, content creation, and marketing.

If you are a creator trying to promote yourself or a company working on marketing, a single TikTok account for your needs won't suffice. Nowadays, innumerable TikTok users have multiple accounts - one for their personal content, another for their business-related content, and even a few for experimenting with different content.

In fact, trying to manage two TikTok accounts on a single phone is not as straightforward as it seems.

This guide will assist you in learning how to resolve the TikTok two accounts on one phone issue, help you understand mistakes you should avoid, and explain how SMMGen can help you manage both accounts efficiently and effectively.

## Why People Need More Than One TikTok Account

Before we get into the "how" of managing multiple TikTok accounts, we should talk about the "why". Having more than one TikTok account can be for many reasons:

- **Personal vs. Professional Use:** Making personal videos on one account separates the fun and creativity of being a creator, which directly relates to the personal videos you are making.
- **Targeting Different Audiences:** One account will serve your lifestyle content, and the other will house more niche content, such as gaming or fashion.
- **Testing Content Strategies:** Many creators utilize a second account to test their content strategy before posting to the main profile.
- **Running Client Accounts:** If you are an influencer marketer or manager, you may be handling several different TikTok accounts at once.

## Step-by-Step Guide to Using Two TikTok Accounts on One Phone

The good news is that TikTok is friendly toward you, allowing you to add multiple accounts on one device. But how you manage those accounts will determine if you run into trouble.

### 1. Use TikTok's Built-In Multi-Account Feature

- Launch TikTok and go to your profile.
- Select your username at the top of your screen, which will reveal the menu you need
- Select "Add account" and either sign up or log in to another account.
- You will be added to the accounts section of the menu and can commonly switch from it.

This method works smoothly if you're only using two accounts.

### 2. Keep Your Login Information Organized

Many users run into complications due to being unable to remember their login details. To keep from forgetting, use a password manager, or keep your account information safe somewhere.

### 3. Avoid Using the Same Phone Number for Both Accounts

TikTok will allow you to link accounts with phone numbers and emails. To limit restrictions, make sure you are using different phone numbers or emails with each account.

### 4. Use Different Content for Each Account

The TikTok algorithm is sensitive to repeated or duplicate content. Instead of reposting videos, you should try to use your other account as a means of unique content, or how a trailer can test where content performs better.

### 5. Be Careful with Third-Party Apps

Some users will find ways to either use cloning apps or other third-party tools to be able to duplicate TikTok on their phone. This will allow them to log into more accounts, but it is dangerous due to security concerns and will trigger restrictions by TikTok. The safest way is always best through TikTok's multi-account feature.

## Tips to Avoid Restrictions When Using Multiple TikTok Accounts

TikTok actively monitors suspicious activity to keep bots and fake accounts off the platform. If you're not careful, your legitimate accounts could get caught in the net. Here's how to avoid that:

- **Do not switch accounts too frequently:** Rapid switching can look suspicious. Give each account some active use before switching again.
- **Post consistently, but naturally:** Both accounts should have steady posting schedules and have consistent rises and falls without unnatural spikes or changes.
- **Engage authentically:** You want to avoid mass-liking, following, or commenting for a short burst of activity. Spread out your engagement so it looks natural for both accounts.
- **Use different emails or numbers:** As mentioned, keeping accounts tied to separate credentials lowers the risk of restrictions.
- **Don't break community guidelines:** If one account is banned for violations, your other account could also face consequences.
